about.title: A small firm with over 20 years of experience
text: At James M. Harrison Law Firm, PLLC, we are committed to achieving the best possible outcomes for your legal matters, whether they involve business law, corporate law, probate, real estate law or wills. We guide clients through every phase of the legal process, so you understand your options and feel confident in your decisions.

As a small firm, we take pride in offering personalized attention to each case. Your legal matters are important to us, and we handle them with the care and diligence they deserve. Whether you need a small business lawyer or assistance with estate planning, we are here to help.
James M. Harrison was born in Pasadena, Texas, raised in Deer Park and is a proud graduate of Deer Park High School.

team.name: James M. Harrison
team.bio: James M. Harrison has been licensed to practice law in Texas since November 2001. He began his legal career as a tax associate with KPMG, LLP, where he worked on complex tax issues involving insurance, corporate income, mergers and acquisitions. He then joined COATS|ROSE, expanding his work to business organization, corporate transactions, restructuring and dissolution, commercial and residential real estate transactions, loan documentation, collections and construction law, before establishing his own practice. At South Texas College of Law he was a member of the South Texas Law Review, made the Dean's List across several semesters, received the Order of the Lytae award and was appointed a Langdell Scholar, graduating Summa Cum Laude in May 2001. He earned a Bachelor of Science in Accounting, Magna Cum Laude, from the University of Houston–Clear Lake. Born in Pasadena and raised in Deer Park, he is a proud graduate of Deer Park High School.
